argv:
t=$(readlink -f /mnt/bko-target) || exit 1; wk=pc-kernel_3908.snap; ws='20240603 label-1'; errs=; nbad=0

m=$data/system-data/var/lib/snapd/modeenv

v() { sed -n "s/^$1=//p" "$m" | tail -n 1; }
mode=$(v mode); [ "$mode" = run ] || err "modeenv says mode=$mode, not run"
ks=$(v current_kernels | tr , ' '); rs=$(v current_recovery_systems | tr , ' ')
[ -n "$ks" ] || err "modeenv names no current_kernels"
for k in $ks; do [ -f "$boot/EFI/ubuntu/$k/kernel.efi" ] || err "modeenv's kernel $k has no EFI/ubuntu/$k/kernel.efi on the restored ubuntu-boot"; done
l=$(readlink "$boot/EFI/ubuntu/kernel.efi" 2>/dev/null); rk=${l%%/*}
if [ -z "$l" ]; then
  err "ubuntu-boot has no EFI/ubuntu/kernel.efi symlink (the run-mode kernel)"
else
  case " $ks " in *" $rk "*) [ -f "$boot/EFI/ubuntu/$l" ] || err "EFI/ubuntu/kernel.efi points at $l, which isn't there" ;; *) err "EFI/ubuntu/kernel.efi points at $l, not at one of modeenv's current_kernels ($ks)" ;; esac
fi
g=$boot/EFI/ubuntu/grubenv
sk=$(sed -n 's/^snap_kernel=//p' "$g" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1)
[ -z "$sk" ] || case " $ks " in *" $sk "*) ;; *) err "the run grubenv's snap_kernel=$sk isn't one of modeenv's current_kernels ($ks)" ;; esac
st=$(sed -n 's/^kernel_status=//p' "$g" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1)
[ -z "$st" ] || err "the run grubenv says kernel_status=$st: a kernel refresh was being tried"
[ -n "$rs" ] || err "modeenv names no current_recovery_systems"
for r in $rs; do [ -f "$seed/systems/$r/model" ] || err "recovery system $r has no systems/$r/model on the restored ubuntu-seed"; done
for k in base gadget; do x=$(v $k); [ -z "$x" ] || [ -f "$data/system-data/var/lib/snapd/snaps/$x" ] || err "modeenv's $k $x isn't in system-data/var/lib/snapd/snaps on the restored ubuntu-data"; done

[ "$ks" = "$wk" ] || echo "snapcore: warning: the restored modeenv's kernels ($ks) aren't the dump's ($wk): the backup was taken after a refresh; the restored tree is what boots" >&2
[ "$rs" = "$ws" ] || echo "snapcore: warning: the restored recovery systems ($rs) aren't the dump's ($ws)" >&2
[ -z "$errs" ] || { printf %s "$errs" >&2; echo "snapcore: $nbad mismatches between modeenv and the restored ubuntu-boot, ubuntu-seed and ubuntu-data" >&2; exit 1; }
echo "snapcore: run mode boots $rk; recovery systems $rs"

# bko-holt load plan for layout.json
# Source: host1, Ubuntu Core 24, UEFI boot with grub, dumped 2026-11-14T19:41:36Z
#
# Disks:
#   vda (8 GiB) -> /dev/sdq
#
# Notes:
#   - Ubuntu Core (unencrypted): restored file for file; it boots unattended on any machine by UEFI
#   - Ubuntu Core: the gadget's BIOS Boot partition is empty (the pc gadget of UC24 boots by UEFI only; its MBR code says "Please boot in EFI mode"), so the restored disk boots by UEFI only, as the source did
#   - Ubuntu Core finds its partitions by label: boot the restored disk with the source's disk (or any other Ubuntu Core disk) detached
#   - Ubuntu Core: ubuntu-seed, ubuntu-boot, ubuntu-save and ubuntu-data are restored as they were; no grub-install, no update-grub, no initramfs, no chroot, and no UEFI entry (shim's fallback on the restored seed makes it at the first boot)

# ---- partition ----
# vda -> /dev/sdq: clear the old table and signatures
wipefs --all /dev/sdq
# /dev/sdq: its first 4 MiB zeroed, and its last 1 MiB (a GPT's backup, md 0.90/1.0 superblocks, ZFS's end labels)
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=1M count=4 conv=fsync
sh -c 'n=$(blockdev --getsz /dev/sdq) && dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=$((n - 2048)) count=2048 conv=fsync'
# the new partitions' old content zeroed through /dev/sdq, before its table names them (blocks of 512 bytes, at their start= sectors)
# vda2: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=4096 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=2459648 count=2048 conv=fsync
# vda3: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=2461696 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=3995648 count=2048 conv=fsync
# vda4: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=3997696 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=4061184 count=2048 conv=fsync
# vda5: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=4063232 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=16775135 count=2048 conv=fsync
# udev done with /dev/sdq before sfdisk takes it
udevadm settle
sfdisk --wipe always --wipe-partitions always /dev/sdq <<'EOF'
label: gpt
label-id: bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
unit: sectors
sector-size: 512
table-length: 128
first-lba: 34
last-lba: 16777182

/dev/sdq1 : start=2048, size=2048, type=21686148-6449-6E6F-744E-656564454649, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002, name="BIOS Boot"
/dev/sdq2 : start=4096, size=2457600, type=C12A7328-F81F-11D2-BA4B-00A0C93EC93B, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003, name="ubuntu-seed"
/dev/sdq3 : start=2461696, size=1536000, type=0FC63DAF-8483-4772-8E79-3D69D8477DE4, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004, name="ubuntu-boot"
/dev/sdq4 : start=3997696, size=65536, type=0FC63DAF-8483-4772-8E79-3D69D8477DE4, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007, name="ubuntu-save"
/dev/sdq5 : start=4063232, size=12713951, type=0FC63DAF-8483-4772-8E79-3D69D8477DE4, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000A, name="ubuntu-data"
EOF
udevadm settle

# ---- assemble ----
# (nothing to do)

# ---- format ----
# vda2: vfat "ubuntu-seed"
mkfs.fat -F 32 -i BC000001 -n ubuntu-seed -S 512 -s 1 -f 2 -R 32 -h 0 /dev/sdq2
# check: /dev/sdq2 is vfat with the source's FAT size, sector and cluster size (read back by bko-holt's own probe)
# vda3: ext4 "ubuntu-boot"
mke2fs -F -q -t ext4 -O none,has_journal,ext_attr,resize_inode,dir_index,filetype,extent,64bit,flex_bg,sparse_super,large_file,huge_file,dir_nlink,extra_isize,metadata_csum -U bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005 -L ubuntu-boot -b 4096 -I 256 -N 48000 -g 32768 -G 16 -E hash_seed=bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006,desc_size=64,resize=197132288 /dev/sdq3 768000k
tune2fs -r 9600 /dev/sdq3
# check: /dev/sdq3 is ext4 with the source's features (read back by bko-holt's own probe)
# vda4: ext4 "ubuntu-save"
mke2fs -F -q -t ext4 -O none,has_journal,ext_attr,resize_inode,dir_index,filetype,extent,64bit,flex_bg,sparse_super,large_file,huge_file,dir_nlink,extra_isize,metadata_csum -U bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000008 -L ubuntu-save -b 1024 -I 256 -N 8192 -g 8192 -G 16 -E hash_seed=bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009,desc_size=64,resize=33554432 /dev/sdq4 32768k
tune2fs -r 1638 /dev/sdq4
# check: /dev/sdq4 is ext4 with the source's features (read back by bko-holt's own probe)
# vda5: ext4 "ubuntu-data"
mke2fs -F -q -t ext4 -O none,has_journal,ext_attr,resize_inode,dir_index,filetype,extent,64bit,flex_bg,sparse_super,large_file,huge_file,dir_nlink,extra_isize,metadata_csum -U bc000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b -L ubuntu-data -b 4096 -I 256 -N 397488 -g 32768 -G 16 -E hash_seed=bc000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000c,desc_size=64,resize=1627389952 /dev/sdq5 6356972k
tune2fs -r 79462 /dev/sdq5
# check: /dev/sdq5 is ext4 with the source's features (read back by bko-holt's own probe)

# ---- mount ----
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/run/mnt/data
# Ubuntu Core: ubuntu-data, at snap-bootstrap's mount point
mount -t ext4 -o defaults /dev/sdq5 /mnt/bko-target/run/mnt/data
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/run/mnt/ubuntu-boot
# Ubuntu Core: ubuntu-boot, at snap-bootstrap's mount point
mount -t ext4 -o defaults /dev/sdq3 /mnt/bko-target/run/mnt/ubuntu-boot
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/run/mnt/ubuntu-save
# Ubuntu Core: ubuntu-save, at snap-bootstrap's mount point
mount -t ext4 -o defaults /dev/sdq4 /mnt/bko-target/run/mnt/ubuntu-save
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/run/mnt/ubuntu-seed
# Ubuntu Core: ubuntu-seed, at snap-bootstrap's mount point
mount -t vfat -o defaults /dev/sdq2 /mnt/bko-target/run/mnt/ubuntu-seed

# ---- restore ----
# snapshot latest of /srv/bko-repo, with BackOtter's restore flags
RUSTIC_STRICT_EXIT=true rustic-bko --repository /srv/bko-repo --no-progress restore --numeric-id latest /mnt/bko-target
# the atimes the restore set, for boot to put back after its reads
sh -c 'mkdir -p -m 700 /run/bko-holt && find /mnt/bko-target \( -path /mnt/bko-target/dev -o -path /mnt/bko-target/proc -o -path /mnt/bko-target/sys -o \( -path '\''/mnt/bko-target/run/*'\'' ! -path /mnt/bko-target/run/mnt ! -path '\''/mnt/bko-target/run/mnt/*'\'' \) \) -prune -o -printf '\''%A@\t%p\0'\'' | LC_ALL=C sort -z > /run/bko-holt/atimes.before'

# ---- boot ----
# refuses to start unless /mnt/bko-target/run/mnt/data/system-data/var/lib/snapd/modeenv is there: the restored ubuntu-data
# the restored atimes (the restore stage lists them), to put back after this stage's reads
sh -c '[ -s /run/bko-holt/atimes.before ] || { mkdir -p -m 700 /run/bko-holt && find /mnt/bko-target \( -path /mnt/bko-target/dev -o -path /mnt/bko-target/proc -o -path /mnt/bko-target/sys -o \( -path '\''/mnt/bko-target/run/*'\'' ! -path /mnt/bko-target/run/mnt ! -path '\''/mnt/bko-target/run/mnt/*'\'' \) \) -prune -o -printf '\''%A@\t%p\0'\'' | LC_ALL=C sort -z > /run/bko-holt/atimes.before; }'
# Ubuntu Core: ubuntu-seed, ubuntu-boot, ubuntu-save and ubuntu-data are restored as they were; no grub-install, no update-grub, no initramfs, no chroot, and no UEFI entry (shim's fallback on the restored seed makes it at the first boot)
# modeenv's kernels and recovery systems are on the restored ubuntu-boot and ubuntu-seed, and the run-mode kernel is one of them
sh -c 't=$(readlink -f /mnt/bko-target) || exit 1; wk=pc-kernel_3908.snap; ws='\''20240603 label-1'\''; errs=; nbad=0
err() { errs="${errs}snapcore: $*
"; nbad=$((nbad + 1)); }
seed=$t/run/mnt/ubuntu-seed; boot=$t/run/mnt/ubuntu-boot; data=$t/run/mnt/data
m=$data/system-data/var/lib/snapd/modeenv
[ -f "$m" ] || { echo "snapcore: system-data/var/lib/snapd/modeenv isn'\''t on the restored ubuntu-data" >&2; exit 1; }
v() { sed -n "s/^$1=//p" "$m" | tail -n 1; }
mode=$(v mode); [ "$mode" = run ] || err "modeenv says mode=$mode, not run"
ks=$(v current_kernels | tr , '\'' '\''); rs=$(v current_recovery_systems | tr , '\'' '\'')

for k in $ks; do [ -f "$boot/EFI/ubuntu/$k/kernel.efi" ] || err "modeenv'\''s kernel $k has no EFI/ubuntu/$k/kernel.efi on the restored ubuntu-boot"; done
l=$(readlink "$boot/EFI/ubuntu/kernel.efi" 2>/dev/null); rk=${l%%/*}

else

fi
g=$boot/EFI/ubuntu/grubenv
sk=$(sed -n '\''s/^snap_kernel=//p'\'' "$g" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1)
[ -z "$sk" ] || case " $ks " in *" $sk "*) ;; *) err "the run grubenv'\''s snap_kernel=$sk isn'\''t one of modeenv'\''s current_kernels ($ks)" ;; esac
st=$(sed -n '\''s/^kernel_status=//p'\'' "$g" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1)
[ -z "$st" ] || err "the run grubenv says kernel_status=$st: a kernel refresh was being tried"
[ -n "$rs" ] || err "modeenv names no current_recovery_systems"
for r in $rs; do [ -f "$seed/systems/$r/model" ] || err "recovery system $r has no systems/$r/model on the restored ubuntu-seed"; done
for k in base gadget; do x=$(v $k); [ -z "$x" ] || [ -f "$data/system-data/var/lib/snapd/snaps/$x" ] || err "modeenv'\''s $k $x isn'\''t in system-data/var/lib/snapd/snaps on the restored ubuntu-data"; done
[ -f "$boot/device/model" ] || err "ubuntu-boot has no device/model"
[ "$ks" = "$wk" ] || echo "snapcore: warning: the restored modeenv'\''s kernels ($ks) aren'\''t the dump'\''s ($wk): the backup was taken after a refresh; the restored tree is what boots" >&2
[ "$rs" = "$ws" ] || echo "snapcore: warning: the restored recovery systems ($rs) aren'\''t the dump'\''s ($ws)" >&2
[ -z "$errs" ] || { printf %s "$errs" >&2; echo "snapcore: $nbad mismatches between modeenv and the restored ubuntu-boot, ubuntu-seed and ubuntu-data" >&2; exit 1; }

'
# vda -> /dev/sdq: the gadget's MBR code, and BIOS Boot's core.img when it has one, byte for byte (UEFI boots shim from the seed)
sh -c 'bko-holt snapcore-boot-areas layout.json vda /dev/sdq'
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/run/mnt/data/system-data/var/log/bko-holt
# this restore's log, on the restored system (/var/log is ubuntu-data's system-data/var/log)
cp -a /run/bko-holt/log/. /mnt/bko-target/run/mnt/data/system-data/var/log/bko-holt/
# the atimes this stage's reads changed, put back
bash -c 'find /mnt/bko-target \( -path /mnt/bko-target/dev -o -path /mnt/bko-target/proc -o -path /mnt/bko-target/sys -o \( -path '\''/mnt/bko-target/run/*'\'' ! -path /mnt/bko-target/run/mnt ! -path '\''/mnt/bko-target/run/mnt/*'\'' \) \) -prune -o -printf '\''%A@\t%p\0'\'' | LC_ALL=C sort -z > /run/bko-holt/atimes.after && LC_ALL=C comm -z -23 /run/bko-holt/atimes.before /run/bko-holt/atimes.after | \

# ---- close ----
# nothing is mounted at /mnt/bko-target itself: every mount under it, read from /proc/self/mountinfo, each before the one it's on

sh -c 'me=$(readlink /proc/self/ns/mnt); seen=" $me "; at() { awk -v t=/mnt/bko-target '\''{ m = $5; i = index(m, t); if (i > 0 && (i + length(t) - 1 == length(m) || substr(m, i + length(t), 1) == "/")) print m }'\'' | LC_ALL=C sort -r; }; for f in /proc/[0-9]*/mountinfo; do grep -q '\''/mnt/bko-target[ /]'\'' "$f" 2>/dev/null || continue; p=${f#/proc/}; p=${p%/mountinfo}; ns=$(readlink /proc/$p/ns/mnt) || continue; case $seen in *" $ns "*) continue;; esac; seen="$seen$ns "; echo "unmounting /mnt/bko-target in $ns (pid $p, $(cat /proc/$p/comm))"; for m in $(at <"$f"); do nsenter -t "$p" -m umount --recursive "$m" || true; done; done; awk '\''{ for (i = 7; i < NF; i++) if ($i == "-") { if ($(i + 1) == "nsfs" && $4 ~ /^mnt:\[/) print $4, $5; break } }'\'' /proc/self/mountinfo | while read -r ns b; do case $seen in *" $ns "*) continue;; esac; seen="$seen$ns "; ms=$(nsenter --mount="$b" cat /proc/self/mountinfo | at); [ -n "$ms" ] || continue; echo "unmounting /mnt/bko-target in $ns (bound at $b)"; for m in $ms; do nsenter --mount="$b" umount --recursive "$m" || true; done; done'

# Nothing was written.  To run it: bko-holt load layout.json ... --through close --commit
